title: What Osiyatech is
content: Osiyatech is a global software engineering partner building, modernizing, and scaling digital products through AI, cloud, web, mobile, and enterprise engineering. Osiyatech partners with founders and engineering leaders to design, build and scale production-grade software across cloud, web, mobile and AI architectures. The company says it does not sell generic agency retainer packages; it designs, architects and ships production software that solves specific operational bottlenecks. It describes itself as 'not another general vendor or dev shop' and says it starts with the business problem rather than the technology. Tagline: 'Your limitless resource'.

title: Osiyatech history and background
content: Founded in 2012 (About page) with a practical goal: understand the business problem and create software that helps solve it. Work began with digital solutions and grew into products, enterprise applications, integration, cloud and emerging technologies. Clients come with different starting points: launching a new idea, improving an existing product, connecting business-critical systems, modernizing infrastructure or using data more effectively.
